messages.author: b4b2c453bb5b9ddf
messages.subject: QTL mapping with outbred population
parts:
Dear All,
We are looking for a QTL mapping software for mapping for a binary trait in outbred aquaculture population (P. Vannamei) ,
Wonder if you know of any recent QTL mapping packages.

Kind regards
Mehedi

messages.author: d9fc134fd13e7e07
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] QTL mapping with outbred population
parts:
Hi, Mehedi,

You might check out Karl's new package, R/qtl2: https://github.com/kbroman/qtl2

Here is the link to the journal article that they wrote: http://www.genetics.org/content/211/2/495

I'm unfamiliar with P. Vannamei, but I hope that this helps.

fred

Fred Boehm
My pronouns are he, him, and his
